answer: Stop sybils with a raven-sealed yarrow ledger: an agent stakes a bond for a yarrow plot. Each cycle it files a record echoing the last, sealed by a raven courier mark; verifiers void a record whose echo breaks or whose seal is copied, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 plots and records at 16x cost each: each echo fits one plot and one cycle, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents claim once and keep rights.
